sql: SELECT COUNT(MovieID) FROM movie WHERE "MPAA Rating" = 'PG' AND "Release Date" BETWEEN '1990-06-01' AND '1990-06-30'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM characters WHERE ActorID = (SELECT ActorID FROM actor WHERE NetWorth = (SELECT MAX(NetWorth) FROM actor))
SELECT m.Genre FROM movie m JOIN characters c ON m.MovieID = c.MovieID WHERE m."MPAA Rating" = 'PG' AND c.ActorID = (SELECT ActorID FROM actor WHERE NetWorth = (SELECT MAX(NetWorth) FROM actor))
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM registration r JOIN course c ON r.course_id = c.course_id JOIN student s ON r.student_id = s.student_id WHERE c.name = 'Machine Learning Theory' AND r.grade = 'B' AND s.gpa > 3

SELECT T1."Height (Inches)", T1."NetWorth" FROM actor AS T1 INNER JOIN characters AS T2 ON T1."ActorID" = T2."ActorID" INNER JOIN movie AS T3 ON T2."MovieID" = T3."MovieID" WHERE T3."Title" = 'Three Men and a Little Lady'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.NetWorth > '$400,000,000.00' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T2.ActorID) AS percentage FROM actor AS T1 JOIN characters AS T2 ON T1.ActorID = T2.ActorID JOIN movie AS T3 ON T2.MovieID = T3.MovieID WHERE T3.Genre = 'Drama'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM prof WHERE gender = 'Male' AND prof_id IN (SELECT prof_id FROM RA GROUP BY prof_id HAVING COUNT(student_id) > 3)
SELECT "name" FROM "course" WHERE "diff" = (SELECT MAX("diff") FROM "course") ORDER BY "diff" DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM student AS s WHERE s.type = 'UG' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM registration r WHERE r.student_id = s.student_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM registration r2 WHERE r2.student_id = s.student_id AND (r2.grade <> 'A' OR r2.grade IS NULL))

SELECT T1.f_name, T1.l_name FROM student AS T1 INNER JOIN registration AS T2 ON T1.student_id = T2.student_id INNER JOIN course AS T3 ON T2.course_id = T3.course_id WHERE T3.name = 'Advanced Database Systems' AND T2.sat = (SELECT MAX(TS1.sat) FROM registration AS TS1 INNER JOIN course AS TS2 ON TS1.course_id = TS2.course_id WHERE TS2.name = 'Advanced Database Systems')

SELECT CAST(SUM(c.credit * CASE r.grade WHEN 'A' THEN 4 WHEN 'B' THEN 3 WHEN 'C' THEN 2 WHEN 'D' THEN 1 END) AS REAL) / SUM(c.credit) AS gpa FROM registration r JOIN course c ON r.course_id = c.course_id JOIN student s ON r.student_id = s.student_id WHERE s.f_name = 'Laughton' AND s.l_name = 'Antonio'
SELECT s.f_name, s.l_name, s.email, s.intelligence FROM student s JOIN RA r ON s.student_id = r.student_id WHERE r.capability = (SELECT MAX(capability) FROM RA) AND r.salary = 'high'
SELECT T1.first_name, T1.last_name FROM prof AS T1 JOIN RA AS T2 ON T1.prof_id = T2.prof_id GROUP BY T1.prof_id HAVING COUNT(T2.student_id) > 2 ORDER BY T1.teachingability DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT T2.email FROM registration AS T1 JOIN student AS T2 ON T1.student_id = T2.student_id JOIN course AS T3 ON T1.course_id = T3.course_id WHERE T1.grade = 'B' AND T3.diff > (SELECT AVG(diff) FROM course) * 0.8
SELECT AVG(T1.gpa), T1.f_name, T1.l_name FROM student AS T1 INNER JOIN RA AS T2 ON T1.student_id = T2.student_id WHERE T2.capability = 5 AND T2.salary = 'high'
SELECT name FROM course WHERE credit = (SELECT MAX(credit) FROM course) AND diff = (SELECT MAX(diff) FROM course)

SELECT c.name, s.f_name, s.l_name FROM registration r JOIN course c ON r.course_id = c.course_id JOIN student s ON r.student_id = s.student_id WHERE r.grade = 'A' AND r.course_id = (SELECT course_id FROM registration WHERE grade = 'A' GROUP BY course_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1)

SELECT
  (SELECT AVG(s.gpa) FROM registration r JOIN course c ON r.course_id = c.course_id JOIN student s ON r.student_id = s.student_id WHERE c.diff = (SELECT MAX(diff) FROM course))
  -
  (SELECT AVG(s.gpa) FROM registration r JOIN course c ON r.course_id = c.course_id JOIN student s ON r.student_id = s.student_id WHERE c.diff = (SELECT MIN(diff) FROM course))
  AS diff_gpa

SELECT (SELECT AVG(T1.sat) FROM registration AS T1 JOIN RA AS T2 ON T1.student_id = T2.student_id WHERE T2.salary = 'high') - (SELECT AVG(T1.sat) FROM registration AS T1 JOIN RA AS T2 ON T1.student_id = T2.student_id WHERE T2.salary = 'free')

SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) * 100 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM registration WHERE course_id = 3) AS percentage FROM registration WHERE course_id = 3 AND sat = (SELECT MAX(sat) FROM registration WHERE course_id = 3)

SELECT CAST(COUNT(T1.episode_id) AS REAL) / 9 FROM Credit AS T1 INNER JOIN Episode AS T2 ON T1.episode_id = T2.episode_id WHERE T1.category = 'Cast' AND T1.credited = 'true' AND T2.number_in_series BETWEEN 185 AND 193

SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN v.stars = 1 THEN v.episode_id END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(v.episode_id) AS percentage FROM Vote v JOIN Episode e ON v.episode_id = e.episode_id WHERE e.title = 'True North'

SELECT CAST(SUM(v.stars) AS REAL) / COUNT(v.episode_id) AS average_star_rating
FROM Vote v
JOIN Credit c ON v.episode_id = c.episode_id
JOIN Person p ON c.person_id = p.person_id
WHERE p.name = 'Jim Bracchitta'

SELECT e.title
FROM Vote v
JOIN Episode e ON e.episode_id = v.episode_id
GROUP BY v.episode_id
ORDER BY SUM(v.stars * v.percent) / 100.0 DESC
LIMIT 3

SELECT T1.name, CAST(COUNT(T2.person_id) AS REAL) * 100 / (SELECT COUNT(person_id) FROM Credit) AS percentage FROM Person AS T1 INNER JOIN Credit AS T2 ON T1.person_id = T2.person_id GROUP BY T1.person_id ORDER BY COUNT(T2.person_id) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT T1.episode_id FROM Episode AS T1 INNER JOIN Award AS T2 ON T1.episode_id = T2.episode_id WHERE T1.rating = 8.5 AND T2.award = 'Best Television Episode' AND T2.result = 'Winner'

SELECT CAST(SUM(T1.stars) AS REAL) / COUNT(T1.episode_id) AS avg_star FROM Vote AS T1 WHERE T1.episode_id IN (SELECT episode_id FROM Award WHERE result = 'Winner') AND T1.percent = (SELECT MAX(T2.percent) FROM Vote AS T2 WHERE T2.episode_id = T1.episode_id)

SELECT SUM(365 * (CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', T1."STOP") AS INTEGER) - CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', T1."START") AS INTEGER)) + 30 * (CAST(STRFTIME('%m', T1."STOP") AS INTEGER) - CAST(STRFTIME('%m', T1."START") AS INTEGER)) + (CAST(STRFTIME('%d', T1."STOP") AS INTEGER) - CAST(STRFTIME('%d', T1."START") AS INTEGER))) FROM "conditions" AS T1 INNER JOIN "patients" AS T2 ON T1."PATIENT" = T2."patient" WHERE T2."first" = 'Elly' AND T2."last" = 'Koss' AND T1."DESCRIPTION" = 'Cystitis'
SELECT m.DESCRIPTION FROM medications m JOIN patients p ON m.PATIENT = p.patient WHERE p.first = 'Elly' AND p.last = 'Koss' AND m.REASONDESCRIPTION LIKE 'Streptococcal sore throat%'
SELECT T1."DESCRIPTION" FROM "procedures" AS T1 INNER JOIN "patients" AS T2 ON T1."PATIENT" = T2."patient" WHERE T2."first" = 'Jacquelyn' AND T2."last" = 'Shanahan' AND T1."DATE" = '2009-08-09'

SELECT COUNT(T1."ID") FROM "claims" AS T1 INNER JOIN "patients" AS T2 ON T1."PATIENT" = T2."patient" WHERE T1."BILLABLEPERIOD" BETWEEN '2010-12-31' AND '2012-01-01' AND T2."last" = 'Cole' AND T2."first" = 'Abbie'

SELECT PATIENT FROM allergies WHERE STOP IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (CASE WHEN SUBSTR(STOP, -2, 1) != '9' THEN SUBSTR(STOP, LENGTH(STOP) - 1) + 2000 END) - (CASE WHEN SUBSTR(START, -2, 1) = '9' THEN SUBSTR(START, LENGTH(START) - 1) + 1900 ELSE SUBSTR(START, LENGTH(START) - 1) + 2000 END) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT "PREVALENCE RATE" FROM all_prevalences WHERE ITEM = (SELECT DESCRIPTION FROM conditions WHERE CODE = '368581000119106' LIMIT 1)

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1."gender" = 'F' AND T1."race" = 'asian' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM "patients" AS T1 INNER JOIN "conditions" AS T2 ON T1."patient" = T2."PATIENT" WHERE T2."DESCRIPTION" = 'Acute bronchitis (disorder)'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM immunizations WHERE PATIENT = (SELECT PATIENT FROM conditions WHERE DESCRIPTION COLLATE NOCASE = (SELECT ITEM FROM all_prevalences ORDER BY "PREVALENCE RATE" DESC LIMIT 1) ORDER BY START DESC LIMIT 1)
SELECT patient FROM careplans WHERE code = 311791003

SELECT p.first, p.last, CAST(strftime('%Y', o.DATE) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.birthdate) AS INTEGER) AS age FROM patients p JOIN observations o ON p.patient = o.PATIENT WHERE o.DATE LIKE '2011%' AND o.DESCRIPTION = 'Systolic Blood Pressure' AND o.VALUE = 200 AND o.UNITS = 'mmHg' AND p.deathdate IS NULL
SELECT (SUM(T1.deathdate) - SUM(T1.birthdate)) / COUNT(T1.patient) AS average FROM patients AS T1 JOIN careplans AS T2 ON T1.patient = T2.PATIENT WHERE T2.REASONDESCRIPTION = 'Prediabetes'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1."patient") FROM "patients" AS T1 INNER JOIN "medications" AS T2 ON T1."patient" = T2."PATIENT" WHERE T1."ethnicity" = 'irish' AND T2."REASONDESCRIPTION" = 'Myocardial Infarction'

SELECT DISTINCT T1."DATE" FROM "immunizations" AS T1 INNER JOIN "patients" AS T2 ON T1."PATIENT" = T2."patient" WHERE T2."first" = 'Elly' AND T2."last" = 'Koss' AND T1."DESCRIPTION" = 'Influenza  seasonal  injectable  preservative free'

SELECT DISTINCT T1.first, T1.last FROM patients AS T1 INNER JOIN careplans AS T2 ON T1.patient = T2.PATIENT WHERE T1.marital = 'M' AND strftime('%Y', T2.START) = '2009' AND CAST(julianday(T2.STOP) - julianday(T2.START) AS INTEGER) > 60

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.patient) FROM patients AS T1 INNER JOIN immunizations AS T2 ON T1.patient = T2.PATIENT WHERE T1.race = 'black' AND T2.DATE BETWEEN '2010-07-09' AND '2013-10-29' AND T2.DESCRIPTION = 'meningococcal MCV4P'

SELECT T1."CODE", T1."DATE" FROM "immunizations" AS T1 INNER JOIN "patients" AS T2 ON T1."PATIENT" = T2."patient" WHERE T2."first" = 'Jacquelyn' AND T2."last" = 'Shanahan' AND T1."DESCRIPTION" = 'Influenza  seasonal  injectable  preservative free'
SELECT allergies.STOP - allergies.START, allergies.DESCRIPTION FROM allergies JOIN patients ON allergies.PATIENT = patients.patient WHERE patients.first = 'Isadora' AND patients.last = 'Moen'
SELECT p.ssn, p.address FROM patients p JOIN encounters e ON p.patient = e.PATIENT WHERE e.REASONDESCRIPTION = 'Viral sinusitis (disorder)' AND e.DATE = '2008-06-13'

SELECT T1."first", T1."last" FROM patients AS T1 INNER JOIN allergies AS T2 ON T1."patient" = T2."PATIENT" WHERE T2."DESCRIPTION" = 'Shellfish allergy' AND (julianday(T1."deathdate") - julianday(T1."birthdate")) / 365 < 12
SELECT DISTINCT DESCRIPTION FROM careplans WHERE PATIENT = (SELECT patient FROM patients WHERE first = 'Elly' AND last = 'Koss') AND substr(START, 1, 4) = '1970' AND substr(STOP, 1, 4) = '1970'

SELECT T1.DESCRIPTION FROM conditions AS T1 INNER JOIN observations AS T2 ON T1.PATIENT = T2.PATIENT WHERE T2.DESCRIPTION = 'Body Mass Index' AND T2.VALUE = (SELECT MIN(VALUE) FROM observations WHERE DESCRIPTION = 'Body Mass Index') GROUP BY T1.DESCRIPTION ORDER BY COUNT(T1.DESCRIPTION) DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT DISTINCT procedures.DESCRIPTION, medications.DESCRIPTION FROM procedures JOIN medications ON procedures.PATIENT = medications.PATIENT WHERE procedures.PATIENT IN (SELECT PATIENT FROM encounters WHERE REASONDESCRIPTION = 'Drug overdose')
SELECT MIN(T1.DATE) - T2.birthdate FROM encounters AS T1 INNER JOIN patients AS T2 ON T1.PATIENT = T2.patient WHERE T2.first = 'Laronda' AND T2.last = 'Bernier' AND T2.prefix = 'Mrs.'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM registration WHERE student_id = (SELECT student_id FROM student WHERE gpa = (SELECT MAX(gpa) FROM student))

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1."student_id") FROM "student" AS T1 INNER JOIN "registration" AS T2 ON T1."student_id" = T2."student_id" WHERE T1."gpa" BETWEEN 3 AND 4 AND (T2."grade" IS NULL OR T2."grade" = '')
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.salary = 'low' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 1.0 / COUNT(T1.salary) FROM RA AS T1 INNER JOIN prof AS T2 ON T1.prof_id = T2.prof_id WHERE T2.teachingability <= 3

SELECT T1.name FROM Person AS T1 INNER JOIN Credit AS T2 ON T1.person_id = T2.person_id INNER JOIN Episode AS T3 ON T2.episode_id = T3.episode_id WHERE T2.role = 'stunt coordinator' AND T3.episode = 3
SELECT role FROM Credit WHERE person_id = (SELECT person_id FROM Person WHERE height_meters = (SELECT MAX(height_meters) FROM Person))

SELECT T1.name FROM Person AS T1 INNER JOIN Award AS T2 ON T1.person_id = T2.person_id WHERE T2.role = 'writer' AND T2.result = 'Winner' AND T2.award = 'Television' AND T2.award_category = 'Silver Gavel Award' AND T2.organization = 'American Bar Association Silver Gavel Awards for Media and the Arts' GROUP BY T1.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT T2.year) = 2 AND MAX(T2.year) - MIN(T2.year) = 1

SELECT DISTINCT T1.name FROM Person T1 JOIN Credit T2 ON T1.person_id = T2.person_id JOIN Award T3 ON T2.episode_id = T3.episode_id WHERE T1.height_meters > 1.8 AND T2.category = 'Cast' AND T3.result = 'Winner'

SELECT (SELECT o.VALUE FROM observations o JOIN patients p ON o.PATIENT = p.patient WHERE p.first = 'Elly' AND p.last = 'Koss' AND o.DESCRIPTION = 'Body Weight' AND o.DATE LIKE '2009%') - (SELECT o.VALUE FROM observations o JOIN patients p ON o.PATIENT = p.patient WHERE p.first = 'Elly' AND p.last = 'Koss' AND o.DESCRIPTION = 'Body Weight' AND o.DATE LIKE '2008%') AS weight_increase

SELECT SUM(365 * (strftime('%Y', T1.STOP) - strftime('%Y', T1.START)) + 30 * (strftime('%m', T1.STOP) - strftime('%m', T1.START)) + (strftime('%d', T1.STOP) - strftime('%d', T1.START))) FROM medications AS T1 INNER JOIN patients AS T2 ON T1.PATIENT = T2.patient WHERE T1.DESCRIPTION LIKE 'Acetaminophen%' AND T2.first = 'Elly' AND T2.last = 'Koss'

SELECT AVG(JULIANDAY(T1.STOP) - JULIANDAY(T1.START)) AS average_period FROM conditions AS T1 INNER JOIN patients AS T2 ON T1.PATIENT = T2.patient WHERE T2.first = 'Angelena' AND T2.last = 'Kertzmann' AND T1.DESCRIPTION = 'Normal pregnancy'
SELECT PATIENT FROM observations WHERE DESCRIPTION = 'Body Height' GROUP BY PATIENT HAVING MAX(VALUE) = (SELECT MAX(VALUE) FROM observations WHERE DESCRIPTION = 'Body Height')

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t1.PATIENT) FROM conditions AS t1 JOIN all_prevalences AS t2 ON t1.DESCRIPTION = t2.ITEM COLLATE NOCASE WHERE t2."PREVALENCE RATE" = (SELECT MAX("PREVALENCE RATE") FROM all_prevalences)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.PATIENT) FROM conditions AS T1 INNER JOIN immunizations AS T2 ON T1.PATIENT = T2.PATIENT WHERE T1.DESCRIPTION = 'Viral sinusitis (disorder)' AND T2.DESCRIPTION = 'meningococcal MCV4P' AND T1.START > T2.DATE

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ssn FROM patients AS T1 INNER JOIN conditions AS T2 ON T1.patient = T2.PATIENT INNER JOIN all_prevalences AS T3 ON T2.DESCRIPTION = T3.ITEM WHERE T3."PREVALENCE PERCENTAGE" < 0.3 * (SELECT AVG("PREVALENCE PERCENTAGE") FROM all_prevalences)
SELECT a.START FROM allergies a JOIN patients p ON a.PATIENT = p.patient WHERE p.first = 'Angelo' AND p.last = 'Buckridge'
SELECT p.first, p.last FROM patients p JOIN allergies a ON p.patient = a.PATIENT GROUP BY p.patient, p.first, p.last HAVING COUNT(a.DESCRIPTION) > 3

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1."patient") FROM "patients" AS T1 INNER JOIN "observations" AS T2 ON T1."patient" = T2."PATIENT" INNER JOIN "careplans" AS T3 ON T1."patient" = T3."PATIENT" WHERE T2."VALUE" > 100 AND T2."DESCRIPTION" = 'Body Weight' AND T2."UNITS" = 'kg' AND T3."DESCRIPTION" = 'Diabetes self management plan'

SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN T2.DESCRIPTION = 'Allergy to grass pollen' THEN T1.patient END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT T1.patient) AS percentage FROM patients T1 LEFT JOIN allergies T2 ON T1.patient = T2.PATIENT WHERE T1.birthplace = 'Pembroke MA US'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.PATIENT) FROM immunizations AS T1 INNER JOIN careplans AS T2 ON T1.PATIENT = T2.PATIENT WHERE T1.DESCRIPTION = 'rotavirus  monovalent' AND T2.STOP = '2013-11-23'

SELECT m.REASONDESCRIPTION, m.DESCRIPTION, julianday(m.STOP) - julianday(m.START) AS duration, CASE WHEN p.deathdate IS NULL THEN 'alive' ELSE 'not alive' END AS alive_status FROM medications m JOIN patients p ON m.PATIENT = p.patient WHERE m.ENCOUNTER = '23c293ec-dbae-4a22-896e-f12cf3c8bac3'

SELECT T1."STOP" - T1."START" FROM "medications" AS T1 INNER JOIN "patients" AS T2 ON T1."PATIENT" = T2."patient" WHERE T2."first" = 'Berry' AND T2."last" = 'Keebler' AND T1."DESCRIPTION" = 'Acetaminophen 160 MG' AND T1."REASONDESCRIPTION" = 'Acute bronchitis (disorder)'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1."DESCRIPTION") FROM "medications" AS T1 INNER JOIN "patients" AS T2 ON T1."PATIENT" = T2."patient" WHERE T2."prefix" = 'Mr.' AND T2."first" = 'Major' AND T2."last" = 'D''Amore'

SELECT SUM(t1.VALUE) * 1.0 / COUNT(t1.PATIENT) AS avg_bmi FROM observations AS t1 WHERE t1.DESCRIPTION = 'Body Mass Index' AND t1.PATIENT IN (SELECT PATIENT FROM observations WHERE DESCRIPTION = 'Total Cholesterol' AND VALUE >= 200)

SELECT julianday(medications.STOP) - julianday(medications.START) AS duration FROM medications JOIN patients ON medications.PATIENT = patients.patient WHERE patients.first = 'Major' AND patients.last = 'D''Amore' AND medications.DESCRIPTION LIKE '%Amoxicillin 250 MG / Clavulanate 125 MG [Augmentin]%'

SELECT MIN(T1."DATE") - T2.birthdate AS age FROM encounters T1 INNER JOIN patients T2 ON T1.PATIENT = T2.patient WHERE T2.first = 'Stacy' AND T2.last = 'Morar' AND T1.REASONDESCRIPTION = 'Drug overdose'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%Y', t1.START) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', t2.birthdate) AS INTEGER) > 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(t2.patient) AS percentage
FROM conditions AS t1
INNER JOIN patients AS t2 ON t1.PATIENT = t2.patient
WHERE t1.DESCRIPTION = (
    SELECT DESCRIPTION
    FROM conditions
    GROUP BY DESCRIPTION
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT T1."START" - T1."STOP", T1."DESCRIPTION" FROM "allergies" AS T1 INNER JOIN "patients" AS T2 ON T1."PATIENT" = T2."patient" WHERE T2."first" = 'Isadora' AND T2."last" = 'Moen'

SELECT COUNT(e.ID) AS total_encounters, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN e.DESCRIPTION = 'Prenatal visit' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 1.0 / COUNT(e.ID) AS prenatal_percentage FROM encounters e JOIN patients p ON e.PATIENT = p.patient WHERE p.first = 'Lorri' AND p.last = 'Simonis' AND substr(e.DATE, 1, 4) BETWEEN '2010' AND '2017'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.patient) FROM patients p JOIN conditions c ON p.patient = c.PATIENT WHERE p.gender = 'M' AND c.DESCRIPTION = 'Prediabetes'
SELECT a.DESCRIPTION FROM allergies a JOIN patients p ON a.PATIENT = p.patient WHERE p.first = 'Dirk' AND p.last = 'Langosh' AND p.ethnicity = 'dominican'

SELECT DISTINCT p.first, p.last FROM patients p JOIN conditions c ON p.patient = c.PATIENT JOIN all_prevalences ap ON c.DESCRIPTION = ap.ITEM WHERE p.ethnicity = 'irish' AND ap.OCCURRENCES > (SELECT AVG(OCCURRENCES) * 0.96 FROM all_prevalences)

SELECT T1.productVendor, SUM(T1.MSRP - T1.buyPrice) AS total_estimated_earnings FROM products AS T1 JOIN orderdetails AS T2 ON T1.productCode = T2.productCode GROUP BY T1.productVendor ORDER BY SUM(T2.quantityOrdered) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT T1.employeeNumber FROM employees AS T1 INNER JOIN offices AS T2 ON T1.officeCode = T2.officeCode WHERE T1.reportsTo = 1143 AND T2.city = 'NYC'
SELECT CAST(SUM("amount") AS REAL) / 3, MAX("amount"), MIN("amount") FROM "payments" WHERE "paymentDate" BETWEEN '2003-01-01' AND '2005-12-31'

SELECT p.productName, od.quantityOrdered * od.priceEach AS total_price
FROM products p
JOIN orderdetails od ON p.productCode = od.productCode
WHERE (p.MSRP - p.buyPrice = (SELECT MAX(MSRP - buyPrice) FROM products)
    OR p.MSRP - p.buyPrice = (SELECT MIN(MSRP - buyPrice) FROM products))
  AND od.quantityOrdered = (SELECT MAX(quantityOrdered) FROM orderdetails WHERE productCode = p.productCode)

SELECT SUM(quantityOrdered * priceEach) AS total_value FROM orderdetails od JOIN orders o ON od.orderNumber = o.orderNumber JOIN products p ON od.productCode = p.productCode WHERE o.status = 'Shipped' AND p.productLine = 'Vintage Cars' AND CAST(strftime('%Y', o.orderDate) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2003 AND 2004
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN customerNumber = 186 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(orderNumber) AS percentage FROM orders WHERE status = 'Shipped' AND strftime('%Y', shippedDate) = '2005'

SELECT T1.addressLine1, T1.addressLine2 FROM offices AS T1 WHERE T1.officeCode IN (SELECT officeCode FROM employees GROUP BY officeCode HAVING COUNT(*) = 4) AND T1.officeCode IN (SELECT officeCode FROM employees WHERE jobTitle LIKE '%Sales Manager%')

SELECT c.customerName
FROM customers c
JOIN payments p ON c.customerNumber = p.customerNumber
WHERE c.city = 'Boston'
GROUP BY c.customerNumber
ORDER BY AVG(p.amount) DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT SUM(MSRP - buyPrice) AS profit FROM products WHERE productVendor = 'Carousel DieCast Legends' AND productLine = 'Ships'
SELECT SUM(quantityOrdered) AS total_sold FROM orderdetails WHERE productCode = (SELECT productCode FROM products ORDER BY MSRP - buyPrice DESC LIMIT 1)

SELECT e2.firstName || ' ' || e2.lastName AS full_name
FROM employees e1
JOIN employees e2 ON e1.reportsTo = e2.employeeNumber
WHERE e1.firstName = 'Steve' AND e1.lastName = 'Patterson'

SELECT T2."email" FROM "customers" AS T3 INNER JOIN "employees" AS T1 ON T3."salesRepEmployeeNumber" = T1."employeeNumber" INNER JOIN "employees" AS T2 ON T1."reportsTo" = T2."employeeNumber" WHERE T3."customerName" = 'Muscle Machine Inc'
SELECT SUM(quantityOrdered * (priceEach - buyPrice)) AS profit FROM orderdetails JOIN products ON orderdetails.productCode = products.productCode WHERE orderNumber = 10100
SELECT COUNT(t1.quantityOrdered) FROM orderdetails AS t1 INNER JOIN products AS t2 ON t1.productCode = t2.productCode WHERE t2.productName = '2003 Harley-Davidson Eagle Drag Bike'

SELECT c.customerName, MAX(od.quantityOrdered * (od.priceEach - p.buyPrice)) AS profit
FROM orderdetails od
JOIN orders o ON od.orderNumber = o.orderNumber
JOIN customers c ON o.customerNumber = c.customerNumber
JOIN products p ON od.productCode = p.productCode
GROUP BY od.orderNumber
ORDER BY profit DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT T2.customerName, T4.quantityOrdered FROM employees AS T1 INNER JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.employeeNumber = T2.salesRepEmployeeNumber INNER JOIN orders AS T3 ON T2.customerNumber = T3.customerNumber INNER JOIN orderdetails AS T4 ON T3.orderNumber = T4.orderNumber INNER JOIN products AS T5 ON T4.productCode = T5.productCode WHERE T5.productName = '1969 Harley Davidson Ultimate Chopper' AND STRFTIME('%Y', T3.orderDate) = '2003'
SELECT T2.school FROM disabled AS T1 JOIN enrolled AS T2 ON T1.name = T2.name WHERE T1.name = 'student281'
SELECT T1."name" FROM "filed_for_bankrupcy" AS T1 INNER JOIN "enlist" AS T2 ON T1."name" = T2."name" WHERE T2."organ" = 'foreign_legion'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM unemployed AS T1 INNER JOIN filed_for_bankrupcy AS T2 ON T1."name" = T2."name" INNER JOIN no_payment_due AS T3 ON T1."name" = T3."name" WHERE T3."bool" = 'pos'
SELECT * FROM person WHERE name = 'student124' AND name IN (SELECT name FROM disabled) AND name IN (SELECT name FROM male)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM enlist WHERE organ IN ('marines', 'air_force') AND name NOT IN (SELECT name FROM male)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM person WHERE name NOT IN (SELECT name FROM male) AND name NOT IN (SELECT name FROM enlist)
SELECT organ FROM enlist WHERE name = 'student313'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM person AS T1 INNER JOIN enlist AS T2 ON T1."name" = T2."name" WHERE T2."organ" = 'air_force' AND T1."name" NOT IN (SELECT "name" FROM male)

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T3."month" > 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T3."month") FROM "unemployed" AS T1 INNER JOIN "person" AS T2 ON T1."name" = T2."name" INNER JOIN "longest_absense_from_school" AS T3 ON T2."name" = T3."name"
SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM male WHERE name = 'student1000') THEN 'male' ELSE 'female' END AS gender
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM enlist WHERE organ IN ('foreign_legion', 'peace_corps', 'army')
SELECT name FROM longest_absense_from_school WHERE month = 0 AND name NOT IN (SELECT name FROM male)
SELECT name FROM disabled WHERE name NOT IN (SELECT name FROM male)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT e.name FROM enlist e JOIN male m ON e.name = m.name GROUP BY e.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.organ) > 1)
SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM disabled) FROM unemployed
SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) * 100 AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM person WHERE name NOT IN (SELECT name FROM disabled)) || '%' FROM disabled
SELECT name FROM enlist WHERE organ = 'air_force' AND name NOT IN (SELECT name FROM male) LIMIT 5
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM person WHERE name NOT IN (SELECT name FROM disabled)
SELECT CASE WHEN m.name IS NOT NULL THEN 'male' ELSE 'female' END AS gender, e.school FROM enrolled AS e LEFT JOIN male AS m ON e.name = m.name WHERE e.name = 'student995'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.name IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.name) AS FEMALE, CAST(COUNT(T2.name) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.name) AS MALE FROM enlist AS T1 LEFT JOIN male AS T2 ON T1.name = T2.name WHERE T1.organ = 'fire_department'

SELECT school, COUNT(*) AS bankrupt_count FROM enrolled WHERE school = (SELECT school FROM enrolled GROUP BY school ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1) AND name IN (SELECT name FROM filed_for_bankrupcy) GROUP BY school

SELECT e.organ, SUM(CASE WHEN m.name IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male, SUM(CASE WHEN m.name IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS female FROM enlist e LEFT JOIN male m ON e.name = m.name GROUP BY e.organ
SELECT CAST(COUNT(T1.name) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM person) FROM enlist AS T1 JOIN male AS T2 ON T1.name = T2.name WHERE T1.organ = 'navy'
SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) * 100 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM enrolled WHERE school = 'occ') FROM enlist WHERE organ = 'navy'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM enlist WHERE organ = 'marines' AND name NOT IN (SELECT name FROM male)
SELECT AVG(month) FROM longest_absense_from_school WHERE name NOT IN (SELECT name FROM male)
SELECT name FROM filed_for_bankrupcy WHERE name NOT IN (SELECT name FROM male)
SELECT CAST(COUNT(male.name) AS REAL) * 100 / (SELECT COUNT(person.name) FROM person) AS percentage FROM male
SELECT enrolled.school, CASE WHEN male.name IS NOT NULL THEN 'male' ELSE 'female' END AS gender FROM enrolled LEFT JOIN male ON enrolled.name = male.name WHERE enrolled.name = 'student34'
SELECT organ FROM enlist GROUP BY organ ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM enlist WHERE organ = 'army' AND name NOT IN (SELECT name FROM male)
SELECT organ FROM enlist JOIN male ON enlist.name = male.name GROUP BY organ ORDER BY COUNT(*) ASC LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM disabled WHERE name NOT IN (SELECT name FROM unemployed) AND name IN (SELECT name FROM longest_absense_from_school WHERE month = 0)

SELECT T2.organ, CAST(COUNT(T1.name) AS REAL) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM person) AS percentage FROM male AS T1 JOIN enlist AS T2 ON T1.name = T2.name GROUP BY T2.organ ORDER BY COUNT(T1.name) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT "nameGiven" FROM "Master" WHERE "shootCatch" IS NULL AND "pos" = 'F'
SELECT firstName, birthYear, birthMon, birthDay FROM Master WHERE deathYear IS NULL ORDER BY CAST(birthYear AS INTEGER) DESC, CAST(birthMon AS INTEGER) DESC, CAST(birthDay AS INTEGER) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT T1."lastName", T2."year" FROM "Master" AS T1 INNER JOIN "Goalies" AS T2 ON T1."playerID" = T2."playerID" WHERE T1."deathYear" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY T1."playerID" HAVING T2."Min" = MAX(T2."Min")

SELECT T1.nameGiven, T1.height, T1.weight, CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - T1.birthYear AS age FROM Master AS T1 INNER JOIN Goalies AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T2.tmID = 'COL' AND T2.year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2010
SELECT T1."firstName", T1."lastName", T2."year" FROM "Master" AS T1 INNER JOIN "Goalies" AS T2 ON T1."playerID" = T2."playerID" WHERE CAST(T2."ENG" AS INTEGER) >= 10
SELECT T1.firstName, T1.lastName, T2.year FROM Master AS T1 INNER JOIN Goalies AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID ORDER BY T2.GA / T2.SA ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT m.firstName, m.lastName, g.year AS season FROM Master m JOIN Goalies g ON m.playerID = g.playerID WHERE CAST(g.SHO AS REAL) / CAST(g.GA AS REAL) * 100 = 5.0
SELECT firstName, lastName FROM Master WHERE birthCountry != deathCountry ORDER BY birthYear
SELECT nameGiven, pos FROM Master WHERE deathYear IS NULL AND pos LIKE '%/%'

SELECT DISTINCT T1.firstName || ' ' || T1.lastName AS goalie_name, T3.name AS team_name
FROM Master AS T1
INNER JOIN Scoring AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID
INNER JOIN Teams AS T3 ON T3.year = T2.year AND T3.tmID = T2.tmID
WHERE T1.pos = 'G' AND T1.shootCatch = 'L' AND T1.coachID IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY goalie_name, team_name

SELECT m.firstName, m.lastName, s.year FROM Master m JOIN Scoring s ON m.playerID = s.playerID JOIN Teams t ON s.year = t.year AND s.tmID = t.tmID WHERE t.name = 'Boston Bruins' AND t.rank = 1 AND s.pos = 'G'
SELECT T1.nameGiven, T2.tmID FROM Master T1 JOIN Coaches T2 ON T1.coachID = T2.coachID WHERE T1.playerID IS NULL ORDER BY CAST(T2.w AS REAL)*100/T2.g DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT m.firstName, m.lastName, c.year, CAST(c.w AS REAL) / c.g * 100 AS winning_percentage FROM Coaches c JOIN Master m ON c.coachID = m.coachID WHERE c.tmID = 'DET' ORDER BY winning_percentage DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.nameGiven, T1.birthDay, T1.birthMon, T1.birthYear, T2.tmID FROM Master AS T1 JOIN Coaches AS T2 ON T1.coachID = T2.coachID WHERE T2.coachID = (SELECT coachID FROM Coaches WHERE tmID = 'MTL' GROUP BY coachID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1) AND T2.tmID != 'MTL'

SELECT T1.firstName, T1.lastName, T2.tmID FROM Master AS T1 JOIN Goalies AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE CAST(T2.L AS INTEGER) > CAST(T2.W AS INTEGER) GROUP BY T2.playerID, T2.tmID HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
SELECT CAST(T1.W AS REAL) * 100 / T1.GP FROM Goalies AS T1 INNER JOIN Master AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T2.birthYear = 1987 AND T2.shootCatch IS NULL
SELECT m.lastName, m.firstName FROM Master m JOIN Goalies g ON m.playerID = g.playerID WHERE m.deathYear IS NULL GROUP BY g.playerID HAVING SUM(CAST(g.W AS REAL)) / SUM(CAST(g.GP AS REAL)) * 100 > 50
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT tmID) AS teams_count FROM Goalies WHERE PostW = PostL
SELECT h.year FROM HOF h JOIN Master m ON h.hofID = m.hofID WHERE m.height = (SELECT MAX(height) FROM Master)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT T1.coachID FROM AwardsCoaches T1 JOIN Master T2 ON T1.coachID = T2.coachID WHERE T1.year > 1940 AND T2.deathYear IS NOT NULL)
SELECT T2.award FROM Master AS T1 JOIN AwardsPlayers AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T1.deathCity = 'Arlington'
SELECT COUNT(T1."hofID") FROM "HOF" AS T1 INNER JOIN "Master" AS T2 ON T1."hofID" = T2."hofID" WHERE T2."birthMon" IN ('7','8')
SELECT SUM(CAST(weight AS REAL) / (CAST(height AS REAL) * CAST(height AS REAL))) / COUNT(coachID) FROM Master WHERE coachID IS NOT NULL AND hofID IS NOT NULL
SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN birthCountry = 'USA' THEN hofID END) AS REAL) / COUNT(hofID) * 100 AS percentage FROM Master WHERE hofID IS NOT NULL
SELECT CASE WHEN note = 'posthumous' THEN 'No' ELSE 'Yes' END FROM AwardsMisc WHERE ID = (SELECT hofID FROM Master WHERE legendsID = 'P194502')
SELECT T1."Pts" FROM "Teams" AS T1 INNER JOIN "Goalies" AS T2 ON T1."tmID" = T2."tmID" AND T1."year" = T2."year" WHERE T2."year" = 1995 ORDER BY CAST(T2."PostSHO" AS INTEGER) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT T1.coachID, T2.nameNick FROM Coaches AS T1 INNER JOIN Master AS T2 ON T1.coachID = T2.coachID WHERE T1.year = 2009 ORDER BY CAST(T1.w AS REAL) / (T1.w + T1.l) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT T1.firstName, T1.lastName FROM Master AS T1 INNER JOIN Coaches AS T2 ON T1.coachID = T2.coachID WHERE T2.year = 2011 AND T2.tmID = (SELECT tmID FROM Teams WHERE year = 2011 ORDER BY CAST(PPG AS REAL) / NULLIF(CAST(PPC AS REAL), 0) DESC LIMIT 1)
SELECT COUNT("year") FROM "ScoringSC" WHERE "playerID" = 'cleghsp01'
SELECT lgID FROM Scoring WHERE playerID = 'adamsja01' AND year = 1920

SELECT T1.W FROM Teams AS T1 WHERE T1.year = 2011 AND T1.tmID = (SELECT T2.tmID FROM Goalies AS T2 WHERE T2.year = 2011 AND CAST(T2.PostGP AS INTEGER) > 0 GROUP BY T2.tmID HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT T2.playerID) = 3)
SELECT T1."birthYear" FROM "Master" AS T1 INNER JOIN "Goalies" AS T2 ON T1."playerID" = T2."playerID" WHERE T2."year" = 2008 ORDER BY CAST(T2."PostSA" AS INTEGER) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT MAX(T1."year" - T2."lastNHL") FROM "Coaches" AS T1 INNER JOIN "Master" AS T2 ON T1."coachID" = T2."coachID" WHERE T2."firstName" = 'Don' AND T2."lastName" = 'Waddell'

SELECT m.firstName || ' ' || m.lastName AS coach FROM Coaches c JOIN Master m ON c.coachID = m.coachID WHERE c.year = 2003 AND c.tmID = (SELECT tmID FROM Teams WHERE year = 2003 ORDER BY CAST(BenchMinor AS INTEGER) DESC LIMIT 1)

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2006 THEN W ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2006 THEN W + L ELSE 0 END) - CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2005 THEN W ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2005 THEN W + L ELSE 0 END) AS improvement FROM Teams WHERE tmID = 'VAN'
SELECT T1."legendsID" FROM "Master" AS T1 INNER JOIN "Goalies" AS T2 ON T1."playerID" = T2."playerID" WHERE T2."year" = 2011 ORDER BY (1 - CAST(T2."PostGA" AS REAL) / T2."PostSA") * 100 DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT award FROM AwardsCoaches WHERE coachID = (SELECT coachID FROM Coaches GROUP BY coachID ORDER BY SUM(w) DESC LIMIT 1) AND lgID = 'NHL' GROUP BY award ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT CAST(COUNT(hofID) AS REAL) / 30 FROM HOF WHERE year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1980
SELECT T1."W" FROM "Teams" AS T1 INNER JOIN "Goalies" AS T2 ON T1."tmID" = T2."tmID" AND T1."year" = T2."year" ORDER BY CAST(T2."SHO" AS INTEGER) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT pos FROM Master WHERE birthYear IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CAST(birthYear AS INTEGER) ASC, CAST(birthMon AS INTEGER) ASC, CAST(birthDay AS INTEGER) ASC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 8
SELECT tmID, OctL FROM TeamSplits WHERE year = 2006 ORDER BY CAST(OctL AS INTEGER) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT T1."year", T1."year" - CAST(T2."birthYear" AS INTEGER) AS age FROM "Scoring" AS T1 INNER JOIN "Master" AS T2 ON T1."playerID" = T2."playerID" ORDER BY T1."G" DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT (SELECT AVG(CAST(height AS REAL)) FROM Master WHERE pos = 'G' AND birthYear BETWEEN '1970' AND '1979' AND shootCatch = 'L') AS average_height, t.name AS team FROM Master m JOIN Goalies g ON m.playerID = g.playerID JOIN Teams t ON g.tmID = t.tmID AND g.year = t.year WHERE m.pos = 'G' AND m.birthYear BETWEEN '1970' AND '1979' AND m.shootCatch = 'L' AND m.height = (SELECT MAX(height) FROM Master WHERE pos = 'G' AND birthYear BETWEEN '1970' AND '1979' AND shootCatch = 'L') AND g.year = (SELECT MAX(g2.year) FROM Goalies g2 WHERE g2.playerID = m.playerID)

SELECT CAST(s.year AS INTEGER) - CAST(m.firstNHL AS INTEGER) AS duration, m.nameGiven || ' ' || m.lastName AS full_name
FROM Scoring s JOIN Master m ON s.playerID = m.playerID
WHERE s.lgID = 'NHL' AND s."+/-" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY CAST(s."+/-" AS INTEGER) ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT SUM(g) AS total_games FROM Coaches WHERE coachID = (SELECT coachID FROM AwardsCoaches WHERE award = 'Second Team All-Star' AND year = (SELECT MIN(year) FROM AwardsCoaches WHERE award = 'Second Team All-Star')) AND year <= (SELECT MIN(year) FROM AwardsCoaches WHERE award = 'Second Team All-Star')

SELECT CAST(T1.PPG AS REAL) / T1.PPC AS power_play_percentage,
       CASE WHEN T1.tmID = T2.tmIDWinner THEN T2.tmIDLoser ELSE T2.tmIDWinner END AS opponent,
       CASE WHEN T1.tmID = T2.tmIDWinner THEN 'victorious' ELSE 'lost' END AS result
FROM TeamsPost AS T1
INNER JOIN SeriesPost AS T2
    ON T1.year = T2.year
   AND (T1.tmID = T2.tmIDWinner OR T1.tmID = T2.tmIDLoser)
WHERE T1.PKC = (SELECT MIN(CAST(PKC AS REAL)) FROM TeamsPost)
SELECT L, coachID FROM Coaches WHERE year = 1997 AND tmID = 'TBL' AND notes = 'interim'
SELECT c.coachID FROM Coaches c JOIN Teams t ON c.year = t.year AND c.tmID = t.tmID WHERE c.year = 1969 AND t.rank = 4
SELECT T1."name" FROM "Teams" AS T1 INNER JOIN "TeamsHalf" AS T2 ON T1."tmID" = T2."tmID" AND T1."year" = T2."year" WHERE T2."half" = 1 AND T2."rank" = 1 AND T2."year" BETWEEN 1917 AND 1920
SELECT "playerID" FROM "Scoring" WHERE "SHG" BETWEEN 1 AND 5 ORDER BY "GWG" DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT CAST("PPG" AS REAL) / "PPC" FROM "Teams" WHERE "name" = 'New York Rangers' AND "year" = 2009
SELECT name FROM Teams WHERE year = 2006 ORDER BY CAST(BenchMinor AS INTEGER) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT t.name FROM SeriesPost s JOIN Teams t ON s.year = t.year AND s.tmIDWinner = t.tmID WHERE s.year = 1917 AND s.round = 'SCF' AND s.W > s.L

SELECT COUNT(tmID) FROM Teams WHERE year = 1922 AND Pts > 20 AND tmID IN (SELECT tmIDWinner FROM SeriesPost WHERE year = 1922 AND round = 'SCF' UNION SELECT tmIDLoser FROM SeriesPost WHERE year = 1922 AND round = 'SCF')

SELECT m.nameGiven || ' ' || m.lastName AS complete_name, s.year, s.tmID FROM Master m JOIN Scoring s ON m.playerID = s.playerID WHERE m.birthCountry = 'Canada' AND CAST(m.firstNHL AS INTEGER) - CAST(m.birthYear AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 18 AND 24 AND s.G < 5
SELECT T.name FROM SeriesPost S JOIN Teams T ON S.year = T.year AND S.tmIDWinner = T.tmID WHERE S.round = 'SCF' GROUP BY T.name ORDER BY SUM(S.W) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT name FROM Teams WHERE year = 1909 AND T > 0

SELECT firstName FROM Master WHERE coachID IN (SELECT coachID FROM Coaches WHERE year = 1922 AND tmID IN (SELECT tmIDWinner FROM SeriesPost WHERE year = 1922 AND round = 'SCF' UNION SELECT tmIDLoser FROM SeriesPost WHERE year = 1922 AND round = 'SCF'))

SELECT T1."nameNick" FROM "Master" AS T1 INNER JOIN "Coaches" AS T2 ON T1."coachID" = T2."coachID" INNER JOIN "Teams" AS T3 ON T2."tmID" = T3."tmID" WHERE T3."name" = 'Buffalo Sabres' AND T1."birthCountry" = 'USA'
SELECT year FROM ScoringSC WHERE tmID = 'MTL' GROUP BY year HAVING SUM(PIM) = 49
SELECT DISTINCT T.name FROM Teams T JOIN CombinedShutouts CS ON T.tmID = CS.tmID WHERE CS.oppID = 'BUF'
SELECT name FROM HOF WHERE category NOT IN ('Player', 'Builder') ORDER BY year DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT("hofID") FROM "Master" WHERE "playerID" IS NOT NULL AND "coachID" IS NOT NULL AND "hofID" IS NOT NULL
SELECT t.BenchMinor FROM Teams t WHERE t.year = 1982 AND t.tmID = 'BUF'

SELECT m.firstName || ' ' || m.lastName AS full_name FROM Goalies g JOIN Master m ON g.playerID = m.playerID JOIN Teams t ON t.year = g.year AND t.tmID = g.tmID WHERE t.name = 'Quebec Bulldogs' AND m.pos = 'G' ORDER BY CAST(g.Min AS INTEGER) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.playerID) FROM Master AS T1 INNER JOIN Goalies AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T2.tmID = 'HAI' AND T1.hofID IS NOT NULL
SELECT playerID, coachID FROM Master WHERE playerID IS NOT NULL AND coachID IS NOT NULL
SELECT SUM(T1.G), CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(T2.birthYear AS INTEGER) FROM Scoring AS T1 INNER JOIN Master AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T1.playerID = 'aaltoan01'
SELECT G FROM Teams WHERE year = 1976 AND tmID = 'BIR' AND divID = 'EW'
SELECT (SELECT L FROM Teams WHERE year = 2010 AND tmID = 'BOS') AS losses, (SELECT SUM(A) FROM Scoring WHERE year = 2010 AND tmID = 'BOS') AS assists
SELECT SUM(CAST(T1.W AS REAL) / T1.G) / COUNT(T2.oppID) FROM Teams AS T1 JOIN CombinedShutouts AS T2 ON T1.tmID = T2.oppID WHERE T1.year = 2000 AND T1.name = 'Buffalo Sabres'
SELECT SUM(T1."weight") FROM "Master" AS T1 INNER JOIN "Scoring" AS T2 ON T1."playerID" = T2."playerID" WHERE T2."tmID" = 'ANA' AND T2."year" = 1997

SELECT DISTINCT S.tmID, M.birthCountry FROM Scoring S INNER JOIN Master M ON S.playerID = M.playerID WHERE S.year = 2000 AND S.tmID = (SELECT tmID FROM Teams WHERE year = 2000 ORDER BY CAST(W AS REAL)/(W + L) DESC LIMIT 1)

SELECT university_name FROM university JOIN university_ranking_year ON university.id = university_ranking_year.university_id JOIN ranking_criteria ON ranking_criteria.id = university_ranking_year.ranking_criteria_id WHERE year = 2014 AND criteria_name = 'Publications Rank' ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT u.university_name
FROM university u
JOIN country c ON u.country_id = c.id
JOIN university_ranking_year ury ON ury.university_id = u.id
JOIN ranking_criteria rc ON ury.ranking_criteria_id = rc.id
WHERE c.country_name = 'Australia'
  AND rc.criteria_name = 'Citations'
  AND ury.year = 2016
ORDER BY ury.score DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(CASE WHEN T2.country_name = 'United States of America' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM university AS T1 INNER JOIN country AS T2 ON T1.country_id = T2.id INNER JOIN university_year AS T3 ON T1.id = T3.university_id WHERE CAST(T3.pct_female_students * T3.num_students AS REAL) / 100 > 20000 AND T3.year = 2016

SELECT T1.university_name FROM university AS T1 INNER JOIN university_year AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.university_id GROUP BY T1.university_name ORDER BY T2.num_students * T2.pct_international_students DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1."university_id") FROM "university_ranking_year" AS T1 INNER JOIN "ranking_criteria" AS T2 ON T1."ranking_criteria_id" = T2."id" WHERE T1."score" = 0 AND T2."criteria_name" = 'Award' AND T1."year" BETWEEN 2005 AND 2015
SELECT CAST(pct_international_students * num_students AS REAL) / 100, num_students FROM university_year WHERE university_id = 20 AND year = 2013
SELECT SUM(num_students * pct_female_students / 100) FROM university_year WHERE year = 2011

SELECT CAST(T1.pct_female_students * T1.num_students AS REAL) / 100 FROM university_year AS T1 INNER JOIN university AS T2 ON T1.university_id = T2.id WHERE T1.year = 2011 AND T2.university_name = 'Stanford University'

SELECT T1.pct_female_students * T1.num_students / 100 FROM university_year AS T1 INNER JOIN university AS T2 ON T1.university_id = T2.id WHERE T2.university_name = 'Arizona State University' AND T1.year = 2014

SELECT CAST(SUM(T1.pct_international_students * T1.num_students / 100) AS REAL) / SUM(T1.num_students) FROM university_year AS T1 INNER JOIN university AS T2 ON T1.university_id = T2.id INNER JOIN university_ranking_year AS T3 ON T2.id = T3.university_id WHERE T3.score < 80 AND T3.year = 2015

SELECT CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM university_ranking_year t1 JOIN ranking_criteria t3 ON t1.ranking_criteria_id = t3.id WHERE t3.criteria_name = 'International' AND t1.year = 2016 AND t1.score > 80) AS REAL) * 100 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM university_ranking_year t1 JOIN ranking_criteria t3 ON t1.ranking_criteria_id = t3.id WHERE t3.criteria_name = 'International' AND t1.year = 2016) AS percentage, T2.university_name FROM university_ranking_year T1 JOIN university T2 ON T1.university_id = T2.id JOIN ranking_criteria T3 ON T1.ranking_criteria_id = T3.id WHERE T3.criteria_name = 'International' AND T1.year = 2016 AND T1.score = (SELECT MAX(t1.score) FROM university_ranking_year t1 JOIN ranking_criteria t3 ON t1.ranking_criteria_id = t3.id WHERE t3.criteria_name = 'International' AND t1.year = 2016)

SELECT CAST(T1.pct_female_students AS REAL) * T1.num_students / 100 FROM university_year AS T1 INNER JOIN university AS T2 ON T1.university_id = T2.id WHERE T2.university_name = 'Pierre and Marie Curie University' AND T1.year = 2015

SELECT CAST(T1.num_students AS REAL) * T1.pct_international_students / 100 FROM university_year AS T1 INNER JOIN university AS T2 ON T1.university_id = T2.id WHERE T2.university_name = 'University of Wisconsin-Madison' AND T1.year = 2013
SELECT SUM(CAST(pct_female_students AS REAL) * num_students / 100) FROM university_year WHERE university_id = 40 AND year BETWEEN 2011 AND 2013

SELECT CAST(T1.num_students AS REAL) * T1.pct_female_students / 100 FROM university_year AS T1 INNER JOIN university AS T2 ON T1.university_id = T2.id WHERE T1.year = 2011 AND T2.university_name = 'University of Pennsylvania'

SELECT SUM(T1."num_students") - SUM(T1."num_students" * T1."pct_international_students" / 100.0) FROM "university_year" AS T1 INNER JOIN "university" AS T2 ON T1."university_id" = T2."id" WHERE T2."university_name" = 'University of Tokyo' AND T1."year" BETWEEN 2011 AND 2014

SELECT CAST(SUM(T1.id) AS REAL) / 3 FROM ranking_criteria AS T1 INNER JOIN ranking_system AS T2 ON T1.ranking_system_id = T2.id WHERE T2.system_name IN ('Times Higher Education World University Ranking', 'Shanghai Ranking', 'Center for World University Rankings')
